sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Alice la Beale Pilgrim is a minor heroine of Arthurian legend. She always kept her face behind a veil. She was a cousin of the fair knight Lancelot and the lover of Alisander le Orphelin. Alisander was held prisoner by Morgan, who came to him as a Fairy Queen. She tried to seduce the pure knight and failed. Writers tell the same tale of Lancelot, and some think the two knights are the same figure.
